17	# Architecture Spine — Company Room Booking
18	
19	## Design Paradigm
20	
21	**Layered modular monolith.** One FastAPI application, one SQLite database, server-rendered HTML. Four feature modules (`people`, `rooms`, `bookings`, `calendar`), each split into three layers:
22	
23	| Layer | Holds | Directory |
24	| --- | --- | --- |
25	| web | FastAPI routes, Jinja2 templates, form parsing, UK-time formatting | `roombooker/<module>/web.py`, `roombooker/templates/<module>/` |
26	| service | Rules (RULE-1 to RULE-4), validation, authorisation, domain errors | `roombooker/<module>/service.py` |
27	| store | SQLAlchemy tables and queries for the tables the module owns | `roombooker/<module>/store.py` |
28	
29	Shared plumbing (settings, database session, `current_person`, error handler, time helpers) lives in `roombooker/core/`.
30	
31	## Invariants & Rules
32	
33	```mermaid
34	flowchart TD
35	    subgraph web["web layer"]
36	        PW[people.web]
37	        RW[rooms.web]
38	        BW[bookings.web]
39	        CW[calendar.web]
40	    end
41	    subgraph service["service layer"]
42	        PS[people.service]
43	        RS[rooms.service]
44	        BS[bookings.service]
45	        CS[calendar.service]
46	    end
47	    subgraph store["store layer"]
48	        PST[people.store]
49	        RST[rooms.store]
50	        BST[bookings.store]
51	    end
52	    PW --> PS
53	    RW --> RS
54	    BW --> BS
55	    CW --> CS
56	    RS --> PS
57	    BS --> RS
58	    BS --> PS
59	    CS --> BS
60	    PS --> PST
61	    RS --> RST
62	    BS --> BST
63	    SEED[seed CLI] --> PST
64	    CORE[core] -.used by all.- service
65	```
66	
67	### AD-1 — Layered modules with one-way dependencies
68	
69	- **Binds:** all epics
70	- **Prevents:** rules written in routes or templates; one module reading or writing another module's tables
71	- **Rule:** web calls only its own module's service; services call other services, never another module's store; a store is imported only by its own service (and the seed CLI for `people.store`). Dependencies follow the diagram above and never point upward or in a cycle.
72	
73	### AD-2 — Server-rendered HTML with htmx `[ASSUMPTION]`
74	
75	- **Binds:** all epics, R16, RULE-9
76	- **Prevents:** one epic building a single-page app while another renders HTML; a second codebase and a JS build step
77	- **Rule:** every surface is a Jinja2 page served by FastAPI. Sheets, panels and refusals are htmx partial swaps (`hx-get`/`hx-post` returning HTML fragments). There is no JSON API and no JS framework or bundler in release one; htmx is a vendored static file. Every route also works on a full page load.
78	
79	### AD-3 — One owner per table
80	
81	- **Binds:** R1 to R16
82	- **Prevents:** two writers of bookings; epic-my-calendar writing its own booking queries
83	- **Rule:**
84	
85	  | Tables | Sole writer | Others read through |
86	  | --- | --- | --- |
87	  | `offices`, `people` | seed CLI (AD-9) | `people.service` |
88	  | `rooms` | `rooms.service` | `rooms.service` |
89	  | `bookings`, `booking_attendees` | `bookings.service` | `bookings.service` |
90	
91	  `calendar` owns no tables; it gets a person's bookings only from `bookings.service`.
92	
93	### AD-4 — Overlaps and closed rooms refused by the database
94	
95	- **Binds:** R5 (booking side), R7 to R11, RULE-1
96	- **Prevents:** double bookings when two people book at once; a code path (change, office-manager edit, settling a closed room's bookings) that forgets the check
97	- **Rule:** `BEFORE INSERT` and `BEFORE UPDATE` triggers on `bookings` raise `ABORT` when another row with the same `room_id` satisfies `other.start_at < NEW.end_at AND NEW.start_at < other.end_at` (half-open intervals, so back-to-back bookings are allowed), or when the room is closed. Every booking write runs in a transaction opened with `BEGIN IMMEDIATE`. `bookings.service` turns the abort into `BookingConflict` or `RoomClosed`. A service-level pre-check may run to build the refusal message and the "still free" suggestions, but the trigger is the guarantee.
98	
99	### AD-5 — Times stored in UTC, shown in UK time
100	
101	- **Binds:** R6 to R14, RULE-2
102	- **Prevents:** naive and aware datetimes mixed across epics; daylight-saving bugs; time-zone conversion done in more than one place
103	- **Rule:** `bookings.start_at` and `end_at` are UTC text `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:00Z`, so text order is time order. Conversion to and from `Europe/London` happens only in the web layer, through `roombooker/core/time.py` (zoneinfo). `bookings.service` checks 15-minute alignment and a length of 15 minutes to 4 hours; the table has `CHECK (end_at > start_at)`.
104	
105	### AD-6 — One way to know the current person
106	
107	- **Binds:** R1, R2, RULE-6
108	- **Prevents:** each epic reading identity in its own way
109	- **Rule:** the cookie `person_id` holds `people.id`, lasts 400 days, is `HttpOnly` and `SameSite=Lax`, and is not signed (RULE-6: anyone may pick anyone). The FastAPI dependency `core.current_person` is the only reader. It redirects to Pick your name when the cookie is missing or names an unknown or inactive person, then returns the person to the requested page.
110	
111	### AD-7 — Authorisation lives in services
112	
113	- **Binds:** R3 to R5, R9 to R11, R13, RULE-3, RULE-4
114	- **Prevents:** checks that exist only in the UI; epics defining "office manager" differently
115	- **Rule:** a service function that changes data takes the acting person and raises `NotAllowed` when RULE-3 or RULE-4 fails. Someone is an office manager of office X exactly when `people.is_office_manager` is true and `people.home_office_id = X`. Templates show or hide controls using the same predicates (`can_manage_office`, `can_change_booking`), never their own logic.
116	
117	### AD-8 — Attendees filtered at the service
118	
119	- **Binds:** R15
120	- **Prevents:** the rooms grid, the details panel and the calendar showing attendees to different people
121	- **Rule:** `bookings.service` returns booking views for a viewer. `attendees` is filled only when the viewer is the organiser, an attendee, or an office manager of the room's office, and is empty otherwise. Templates never load attendees themselves.
122	
123	### AD-9 — People and offices come only from the seed file
124	
125	- **Binds:** R1, the user's 2026-11-12 seed decision
126	- **Prevents:** reloading HR's list changing `people.id`, which would break cookies and bookings; a second import path
127	- **Rule:** `python -m roombooker.seed <file.csv>` upserts offices and people, keyed on the person's email `[ASSUMPTION]`. A person missing from a later file is marked `active = false`, never deleted `[ASSUMPTION]`. The build seed file and HR's list use the same command and format.
128	
129	### AD-10 — Schema changes only through migrations
130	
131	- **Binds:** all epics
132	- **Prevents:** schema drift between environments; the AD-4 triggers going missing
133	- **Rule:** every table, index, check and trigger is created by an Alembic migration. `alembic upgrade head` runs as a deploy step before the app starts. Nothing calls `create_all` outside tests.
134	
135	### AD-11 — One instance, one host, private reach
136	
137	- **Binds:** OQ-4, RULE-7, RULE-9, the initiative's Done when
138	- **Prevents:** a second app instance or network storage corrupting SQLite; losing the database; staff names reachable from the internet with no sign-in
139	- **Rule:**
140	  - Exactly one app container runs, on one host, with the SQLite file on a local persistent volume.
141	  - SQLite runs with `journal_mode=WAL`, `busy_timeout=5000` and `foreign_keys=ON`.
142	  - Caddy terminates HTTPS in front of the app.
143	  - Litestream replicates the database continuously to object storage off the host.
144	  - Only company networks (office Wi-Fi and VPN) can reach the app `[ASSUMPTION]`.
145	  - The host is a small Linux VM in a UK region, run by the company or in the cloud `[ASSUMPTION]`.
146	
147	### AD-12 — One error path
148	
149	- **Binds:** R8, R11, all forms
150	- **Prevents:** each route inventing its own error shape and wording
151	- **Rule:** services raise `BookingConflict`, `RoomClosed`, `NotAllowed` or `InvalidBooking`. One handler in `core` maps them to 409, 409, 403 and 422 and renders the message fragment in the EXPERIENCE.md voice, inside an `aria-live` region.
152	
153	### AD-13 — Cancelling deletes `[ASSUMPTION]`
154	
155	- **Binds:** R11, R12, R13
156	- **Prevents:** epic-my-calendar having to know about a "cancelled" state invented in epic-find-and-book
157	- **Rule:** cancelling deletes the booking and its `booking_attendees` rows. `bookings` has no status column. Revisit when OQ-3 (retention) is answered.
158	
159	## Consistency Conventions
160	
161	| Concern | Convention |
162	| --- | --- |
163	| Naming | Package `roombooker`; tables plural `snake_case`; route paths `/rooms`, `/my-bookings`, `/manage-rooms`, `/bookings/{id}`, `/pick-name` |
164	| IDs | Integer primary keys; `people.email` is the external key |
165	| Dates on screen | `14:00`, `Tue 17 Nov`, 24-hour UK time, through Jinja filters in `core/time.py` only |
166	| Writes | HTML form `POST` only, including change and cancel (`POST /bookings/{id}/cancel`); fragment responses for htmx requests, redirect-after-post otherwise |
167	| Styling | DESIGN.md tokens as CSS custom properties in `static/tokens.css`; no CSS framework `[ASSUMPTION]` |
168	| Config | Environment variables read in `core/settings.py` only (`ROOMBOOKER_DB_PATH`, `ROOMBOOKER_ENV`) |
169	| Logging | stdlib `logging` to stdout; every write logs the acting `person_id`, the action and the target id (evidence for SM-5) |
170	| Tests | pytest with FastAPI `TestClient` against a temporary SQLite file migrated to head; a concurrency test proves AD-4 |
171	
172	## Stack
173	
174	| Name | Version |
175	| --- | --- |
176	| Python | 3.14 |
177	| FastAPI | 0.162.5 |
178	| Uvicorn | 0.54.0 |
179	| Jinja2 | 3.1.6 |
180	| python-multipart | 0.0.33 |
181	| SQLAlchemy | 2.1.8 |
182	| Alembic | 1.20.1 |
183	| SQLite | bundled with Python |
184	| htmx | 2.0.11 |
185	| pytest | 9.2.0 |
186	| httpx | 0.28.1 |
187	| uv | project and dependency manager |
188	| Caddy | 2.x, exact version pinned at the deployment story (unverified) |
189	| Litestream | exact version pinned at the deployment story (unverified) |
190	
191	## Structural Seed
192	
193	```mermaid
194	erDiagram
195	    offices ||--o{ people : "home office of"
196	    offices ||--o{ rooms : has
197	    rooms ||--o{ bookings : "booked as"
198	    people ||--o{ bookings : organises
199	    bookings ||--o{ booking_attendees : lists
200	    people ||--o{ booking_attendees : attends
201	```
202	
203	```mermaid
204	flowchart LR
205	    subgraph company["Company networks: office Wi-Fi, VPN"]
206	        L[Laptop browser]
207	        P[Phone browser]
208	    end
209	    subgraph host["One Linux VM, UK region"]
210	        C[Caddy, HTTPS]
211	        A[roombooker container, Uvicorn]
212	        V[(Volume: roombooker.db, WAL)]
213	        LS[Litestream]
214	    end
215	    O[(Off-host object storage)]
216	    L --> C
217	    P --> C
218	    C --> A
219	    A --> V
220	    LS --> V
221	    LS --> O
222	```
223	
224	| Environment | What runs | Data |
225	| --- | --- | --- |
226	| Local | `uv run uvicorn`, SQLite file in the repo's ignored `var/` | build seed file |
227	| Production | AD-11 host | build seed before go-live (office managers enter rooms), then HR's list loaded with the same command |
228	
229	```text
230	roombooker/
231	  core/          # settings, db session, current_person, errors, time
232	  people/        # web, service, store; pick your name
233	  rooms/         # web, service, store; manage rooms
234	  bookings/      # web, service, store; rooms view, booking sheet, details panel
235	  calendar/      # web, service; my bookings
236	  seed.py        # CLI for AD-9
237	  templates/     # base.html shell, one folder per module
238	  static/        # tokens.css, app.css, htmx.min.js
239	migrations/      # Alembic, including AD-4 triggers
240	tests/
241	deploy/          # Dockerfile, Caddyfile, litestream.yml
242	```
243	
244	## Capability → Architecture Map
245	
246	| Capability / Area | Lives in | Governed by |
247	| --- | --- | --- |
248	| R1, R2 pick and switch name | `people`, `core.current_person` | AD-6, AD-9 |
249	| R3, R4 add and edit rooms | `rooms` | AD-3, AD-7 |
250	| R5 close and reopen (room side) | `rooms` | AD-7 |
251	| R5 refuse bookings of a closed room | `bookings`, trigger | AD-4 |
252	| R6 free rooms by office, date, time, length | `bookings.service` (reads `rooms`) | AD-1, AD-5, RULE-8 |
253	| R7 book with attendees (making it) | `bookings` | AD-4, AD-5, AD-12 |
254	| R7 shows in organiser's and attendees' calendars | `calendar` via `bookings.service` | AD-3, AD-8 |
255	| R8 overlap refused | trigger, `bookings.service` | AD-4, AD-12 |
256	| R9, R10, R11 change and cancel | `bookings` | AD-4, AD-7, AD-13 |
257	| R12, R13, R14 my calendar | `calendar` | AD-3, AD-5, AD-7 |
258	| R15 attendee visibility | `bookings.service` | AD-8 |
259	| R16 three taps, no typing | `bookings.web` templates | AD-2 |
260	| RULE-8 under 10 seconds | server-rendered first paint | AD-2 |
261	| Hosting (OQ-4) | `deploy/` | AD-11 |
262	
263	## Deferred
264	
265	- **The fate of a closed room's future bookings:** decided when epic-find-and-book is refined. The AD-4 trigger allows deleting them or moving them to an open room.
266	- **The exact hosting provider and network restriction:** the user decides with IT. This blocks epic 1's deployment story, not its other stories.
267	- **Retention of past bookings and attendee lists (OQ-3):** answered before go-live, and may revisit AD-13 or add a purge job.
268	- **HR file column names:** confirmed with HR. The seed format adapts, and AD-9's email key holds.
269	- **CI provider, browser end-to-end tool, and monitoring beyond logs and Litestream:** chosen in epic 1's baseline stories.
270	- **A staging environment:** none planned. Production before go-live is the rehearsal.

- **Prevents:** epic-my-calendar having to know about a "cancelled" state invented in epic-find-and-book
- **Rule:** cancelling deletes the booking and its `booking_attendees` rows. `bookings` has no status column. Revisit when OQ-3 (retention) is answered.

## Consistency Conventions

| Concern | Convention |
| --- | --- |
| Naming | Package `roombooker`; tables plural `snake_case`; route paths `/rooms`, `/my-bookings`, `/manage-rooms`, `/bookings/{id}`, `/pick-name` |
| IDs | Integer primary keys; `people.email` is the external key |
| Dates on screen | `14:00`, `Tue 17 Nov`, 24-hour UK time, through Jinja filters in `core/time.py` only |
| Writes | HTML form `POST` only, including change and cancel (`POST /bookings/{id}/cancel`); fragment responses for htmx requests, redirect-after-post otherwise |
| Styling | DESIGN.md tokens as CSS custom properties in `static/tokens.css`; no CSS framework `[ASSUMPTION]` |
| Config | Environment variables read in `core/settings.py` only (`ROOMBOOKER_DB_PATH`, `ROOMBOOKER_ENV`) |
| Logging | stdlib `logging` to stdout; every write logs the acting `person_id`, the action and the target id (evidence for SM-5) |
| Tests | pytest with FastAPI `TestClient` against a temporary SQLite file migrated to head; a concurrency test proves AD-4 |

## Stack

| Name | Version |
| --- | --- |
| Python | 3.14 |
| FastAPI | 0.162.5 |
| Uvicorn | 0.54.0 |
| Jinja2 | 3.1.6 |
| python-multipart | 0.0.33 |
| SQLAlchemy | 2.1.8 |
| Alembic | 1.20.1 |
| SQLite | bundled with Python |
| htmx | 2.0.11 |
| pytest | 9.2.0 |
| httpx | 0.28.1 |
| uv | project and dependency manager |
| Caddy | 2.x, exact version pinned at the deployment story (unverified) |
| Litestream | exact version pinned at the deployment story (unverified) |

## Structural Seed

```mermaid
erDiagram
    offices ||--o{ people : "home office of"
    offices ||--o{ rooms : has
    rooms ||--o{ bookings : "booked as"
    people ||--o{ bookings : organises
    bookings ||--o{ booking_attendees : lists
    people ||--o{ booking_attendees : attends
```

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    subgraph company["Company networks: office Wi-Fi, VPN"]
        L[Laptop browser]
        P[Phone browser]
    end
    subgraph host["One Linux VM, UK region"]
        C[Caddy, HTTPS]
        A[roombooker container, Uvicorn]
        V[(Volume: roombooker.db, WAL)]
        LS[Litestream]
    end
    O[(Off-host object storage)]
    L --> C
    P --> C
    C --> A
    A --> V
    LS --> V
    LS --> O
```

| Environment | What runs | Data |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Local | `uv run uvicorn`, SQLite file in the repo's ignored `var/` | build seed file |
| Production | AD-11 host | build seed before go-live (office managers enter rooms), then HR's list loaded with the same command |

```text
roombooker/
  core/          # settings, db session, current_person, errors, time
  people/        # web, service, store; pick your name
  rooms/         # web, service, store; manage rooms
  bookings/      # web, service, store; rooms view, booking sheet, details panel
  calendar/      # web, service; my bookings
  seed.py        # CLI for AD-9
  templates/     # base.html shell, one folder per module
  static/        # tokens.css, app.css, htmx.min.js
migrations/      # Alembic, including AD-4 triggers
tests/
deploy/          # Dockerfile, Caddyfile, litestream.yml
```

## Capability → Architecture Map

| Capability / Area | Lives in | Governed by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| R1, R2 pick and switch name | `people`, `core.current_person` | AD-6, AD-9 |
| R3, R4 add and edit rooms | `rooms` | AD-3, AD-7 |
| R5 close and reopen (room side) | `rooms` | AD-7 |
| R5 refuse bookings of a closed room | `bookings`, trigger | AD-4 |
| R6 free rooms by office, date, time, length | `bookings.service` (reads `rooms`) | AD-1, AD-5, RULE-8 |
| R7 book with attendees (making it) | `bookings` | AD-4, AD-5, AD-12 |
| R7 shows in organiser's and attendees' calendars | `calendar` via `bookings.service` | AD-3, AD-8 |
| R8 overlap refused | trigger, `bookings.service` | AD-4, AD-12 |
| R9, R10, R11 change and cancel | `bookings` | AD-4, AD-7, AD-13 |
| R12, R13, R14 my calendar | `calendar` | AD-3, AD-5, AD-7 |
| R15 attendee visibility | `bookings.service` | AD-8 |
| R16 three taps, no typing | `bookings.web` templates | AD-2 |
| RULE-8 under 10 seconds | server-rendered first paint | AD-2 |
| Hosting (OQ-4) | `deploy/` | AD-11 |

## Deferred

- **The fate of a closed room's future bookings:** decided when epic-find-and-book is refined. The AD-4 trigger allows deleting them or moving them to an open room.
- **The exact hosting provider and network restriction:** the user decides with IT. This blocks epic 1's deployment story, not its other stories.
- **Retention of past bookings and attendee lists (OQ-3):** answered before go-live, and may revisit AD-13 or add a purge job.
- **HR file column names:** confirmed with HR. The seed format adapts, and AD-9's email key holds.
- **CI provider, browser end-to-end tool, and monitoring beyond logs and Litestream:** chosen in epic 1's baseline stories.
- **A staging environment:** none planned. Production before go-live is the rehearsal.

| Surface | Reached from | Purpose | PRD |

Settles PRD OQ-2 (user): **anyone can see a booking's title and who booked it.** It's an internal tool.

| Detail | Who sees it |

| Room is taken, time, title, organiser | Everyone |

Microcopy. Brand posture lives in `DESIGN.md`.

| Do | Don't |
|---|---|
| "Booked. Atlas, 14:00–14:30." | "Your booking was created successfully!" |
| "Someone just booked Atlas at 14:00. These rooms are still free:" | "Error 409: conflict" |
| "Free until 15:30" | "Available for the next 90 minutes" |
| "Closed" | "Unavailable (room status: inactive)" |
| "No bookings this week." | "Looks like you have nothing planned! 🎉" |
| Times as 14:00, dates as "Tue 17 Nov" [ASSUMPTION] | 2pm, 11/17 |

Short, plain, no exclamation marks. Name the room and the time in every confirmation.

| Component | Use | Behavioral rules |

| Name picker | Pick your name | Type-ahead search over all ~300 people; shows name and home office. Picking sets the current person on this device and opens Rooms. |

Rooms already taken for the next hour sit below a "Busy now" heading; closed rooms are hidden from the list [ASSUMPTION]. A length choice (30 min / 1 h / 2 h) filters to rooms free for that long [ASSUMPTION]. |

Attendees optional, picked by type-ahead. Length: 15 min to 4 h in 15-minute steps (PRD RULE-2). "Book" is the only primary action. |

- **Tap or click** to act. No drag, no swipe gestures, no long-press in release one [ASSUMPTION].

- **Times snap to 15 minutes** in every picker (PRD RULE-2).

## Responsive & Platform

|---|---|---|---|
| ≥ 768px (laptop) | Day grid, all rooms visible | Week grid or day column | Centred panel |
| < 768px (phone) | Next free rooms list, not a calendar (user) | Day list by default; week as seven day-headed lists [ASSUMPTION] | Bottom sheet |

Tabs stay in the top bar at every width [ASSUMPTION]. Manage rooms works on phone as a simple list, but is designed laptop-first [ASSUMPTION].

## Key Flows

Journey names mirror the PRD. Protagonists are roles, because no real session was narrated [ASSUMPTION, PRD A1].

### UJ-1: A Leeds staff member books a room for this afternoon

1. Opens the app on their phone. It remembers their name, so Rooms opens on Leeds, today.
2. The next free rooms list shows rooms free from 14:00. They choose "1 h".
3. They tap "Book" on a room showing "Free until 16:00".
4. The booking sheet opens with room, 14:00–15:00 and "{Name}'s meeting" filled in. They add two colleagues as attendees.

Failure: someone booked that room a moment earlier. The sheet shows the refusal and three rooms still free at 14:00; one tap books another.

### UJ-2: A Manchester staff member books a room in London for a visit

2. The day grid shows London's rooms; they tap a free slot at 10:00.
3. In the sheet they set the length to 2 h and add London colleagues.
4. **Climax:** "Book". The slot turns solid navy, with their title on it, in London's grid.

### UJ-3: An organiser moves and cancels meetings

1. They open My bookings, week view.
2. They tap a meeting; details show "Change" and "Cancel booking".
3. "Change": they move it to Thursday 11:00; the app checks the room is free and saves.
4. They open another meeting and tap "Cancel booking", then confirm.
5. **Climax:** the week view updates at once; the cancelled room shows as free in Rooms for everyone.

### UJ-4: A London office manager closes a room for repairs

1. They open Manage rooms; the table lists London's rooms.
2. "Close" on a room: the confirmation says it has 3 future bookings and that closing stops new bookings.
3. They confirm; the room shows "Closed" in the grid. Later they "Add room" for a newly fitted room.
4. From the Rooms grid they tap someone's booking in a London room; as an office manager they see "Change" and "Cancel booking" and move it to free the slot for an urgent meeting.
5. **Climax:** the grid shows the closed room greyed out, the new room open, and the urgent slot free. The room list matches reality.

## Open items

- What happens to future bookings when a room closes is decided in the rooms epic (PRD FR-5); the UX only shows the count.
- Exact company navy and any logo: to be supplied; DESIGN.md hex values stand until then.

## Intent

**Problem:** There is no code yet. Every later story needs the app scaffold, the seeded people and offices, the page layout and one trusted way to know who is using the app.

**Approach:** A tracer bullet that runs locally. It scaffolds `roombooker` per the architecture Stack and Structural Seed, loads people from the R8 CSV, serves Pick your name with type-ahead inside the `base.html` layout, remembers the pick in the `person_id` cookie read only by `core.current_person`, and lets a person switch name from the top bar.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:** AD-1 layering (seed CLI is the only other importer of `people.store`); AD-6 cookie `person_id` = `people.id`, 400 days, `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Lax`, unsigned, `Secure` only when `ROOMBOOKER_ENV=production`; AD-10 schema only via Alembic; AD-11 pragmas `journal_mode=WAL`, `busy_timeout=5000`, `foreign_keys=ON` on every connection; settings only from `ROOMBOOKER_DB_PATH` (default `var/roombooker.db`) and `ROOMBOOKER_ENV` (default `local`); every route works on a full page load and enhances with htmx; DESIGN.md tokens as CSS custom properties; tap targets ≥ 44px, body text 16px; stdlib logging of each seed run and each pick, naming the `person_id`.

**Never:** rooms, bookings, tabs (R9: no screen exists yet), Docker/Caddy/Litestream, CI, a JSON API, a JS framework or bundler, a CSS framework, `create_all` outside tests, deleting people, editing people or offices in the app.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| First load | CSV `email,name,office,office_manager`; empty DB | Offices created by name; people inserted active; `office_manager` true for `true/yes/1` (any case), false for `false/no/0`/blank | No error |
| Reload | CSV drops person A, changes B's name, re-adds inactive C | A `active=false` with the same id; B updated in place (same id); C active again; offices never deleted | No error |
| Bad CSV | Missing column, duplicate email, unknown `office_manager` value, empty name or email | Nothing written | Non-zero exit, message names the row and problem |
| Search | `q="ann"` | Active people whose name contains it, case-insensitive, sorted by name, max 20, each with home office | Empty `q` shows "Start typing your name."; no match shows "No one called “{q}”." |
| Pick | POST person id + `next` | Cookie set; 303 to `next`, or `/` when absent | Inactive or unknown id → back to Pick your name; `next` that is not a local path (`//x`, `http://x`) → `/` |
| Guarded page | No cookie, junk cookie, unknown or inactive id | 303 to `/pick-name?next=<requested path+query>`; htmx request gets `HX-Redirect` instead | Bad cookie is cleared |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

The repo is empty apart from `README.md` and the BMad install (`_bmad/`, `.claude/`, `_bmad-output/`), so everything below is new. Follow the architecture Structural Seed tree and Consistency Conventions.

- `pyproject.toml`, `.python-version` (3.14), `uv.lock` -- the exact Stack pins (FastAPI 0.162.5, Uvicorn 0.54.0, Jinja2 3.1.6, python-multipart 0.0.33, SQLAlchemy 2.1.8, Alembic 1.20.1); dev group pytest 9.2.0, httpx 0.28.1, playwright 1.65.1, pytest-playwright 0.10.0 (all checked to resolve)
- `roombooker/core/` -- `settings.py`, `db.py` (engine + pragmas via a `connect` event, session dependency), `identity.py` (`current_person` dependency + the redirect exception and its handler). `identity.py` imports `people.service`; `people.service` must never import `core.identity`
- `roombooker/people/{store,service,web}.py` -- tables `offices(id, name unique)`, `people(id, email unique, name, home_office_id FK, is_office_manager, active)`; service exposes `search_active_people`, `get_active_person`; web serves `/pick-name` (GET page, GET fragment for htmx, POST pick) and `/` ("Booking opens soon.")
- `roombooker/seed.py` -- `python -m roombooker.seed <file.csv>`, one transaction
- `roombooker/app.py` -- app factory, static mount, Jinja env, exception handler
- `roombooker/templates/base.html`, `templates/people/` -- the layout: navy top bar with app name and current name linking to `/pick-name?next=<this page>`; `aria-live` region
- `roombooker/static/` -- `tokens.css` (every DESIGN.md token), `app.css`, `htmx.min.js` 2.0.11 (vendored)
- `migrations/`, `alembic.ini` -- `env.py` takes its URL from `core.settings`; first revision creates `offices` and `people`
- `seeds/build-people.csv` -- about 30 invented people (`@example.com`), roughly 10 per office, at least one office manager per office
- `tests/` -- `conftest.py` makes a temp DB migrated to head via Alembic; `e2e/` runs Uvicorn on a temp DB with Playwright
- `.gitignore` -- `var/`, `.venv/`, caches; `README.md` -- install, migrate, seed, run, test

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `pyproject.toml`, `.python-version`, `.gitignore`, `alembic.ini` -- uv project with the pins above, `uv lock` -- Stack is binding
- [ ] `roombooker/core/settings.py`, `roombooker/core/db.py` -- settings and engine with AD-11 pragmas; create the parent folder of the DB path -- one way to configure and connect
- [ ] `migrations/env.py`, `migrations/versions/0001_offices_people.py` -- the two tables, unique email and office name -- AD-10
- [ ] `roombooker/people/store.py`, `roombooker/people/service.py` -- queries and the upsert used by seed; search and lookup for the web -- AD-1, AD-3
- [ ] `roombooker/seed.py`, `seeds/build-people.csv` -- load/reload per the matrix -- R8, AD-9
- [ ] `roombooker/core/identity.py` -- `current_person` and redirect handling per the matrix -- AD-6
- [ ] `roombooker/app.py`, `roombooker/people/web.py`, templates, static -- picker with `hx-get` on input (`delay:200ms`) plus a plain GET form fallback; each result is a POST form button showing name and home office; `/` shows the name and "Booking opens soon." -- R1, R2
- [ ] `tests/` -- one test per matrix row and per acceptance criterion through `TestClient`, plus Playwright e2e for the ticket's verify at 1280×800 and 390×844; no test may repeat what another test already proves -- test policy
- [ ] `README.md` -- commands to install, migrate, seed, run and test -- the user's first local run

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given the build seed is loaded, when a person types part of a name on Pick your name and picks it, then the top bar shows that name, and still does after a browser reload.
- Given a person is on any page, when they choose their name in the top bar and pick another, then they return to the same page showing the new name.
- Given a person picked their name, when a reload of the seed drops them, then their next request goes to Pick your name, where they no longer appear, and everyone else's `people.id` is unchanged.
- Given a fresh checkout, when the README commands run in order, then the app serves Pick your name at `http://127.0.0.1:8000/`.

## Design Notes

The landing page `/` belongs to `people.web` for now. Story 2 sends office managers to `/manage-rooms`, and epic-find-and-book replaces the landing with Rooms. Redirect through an exception raised by `current_person` and handled once in `app.py`, so no route checks identity itself:

```python
class NeedsPerson(Exception):
    def __init__(self, next_url: str): self.next_url = next_url
# handler: htmx -> 200 + HX-Redirect; else 303 Location=/pick-name?next=...; delete bad cookie
```

**Commands:**
- `uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run python -m roombooker.seed seeds/build-people.csv` -- expected: exits 0, logs offices and people loaded
- `uv run pytest` -- expected: all pass, including e2e at both widths
- `uv run uvicorn roombooker.app:app` then `curl -sI http://127.0.0.1:8000/` -- expected: 303 to `/pick-name?next=/`

- **Project setup:** a `uv` project pinned to the architecture's Stack versions (I checked they all install on Python 3.14), plus settings, the SQLite connection with the required WAL / busy-timeout / foreign-keys settings, and an Alembic migration for the `offices` and `people` tables.
- **Seed command:** `python -m roombooker.seed <csv>` loads or reloads the people list in one transaction. People are matched on email, and anyone missing from a reload is marked inactive with the same id. A bad file writes nothing and exits with an error naming the row. It comes with a made-up build seed of about 30 people.
- **Pick your name:** live search as you type (htmx) that also works without JavaScript. It searches active people only and shows each person's name and home office.

106	+## Intent
107	+
108	+**Problem:** There is no code yet. Every later story needs the app scaffold, the seeded people and offices, the page layout and one trusted way to know who is using the app.
109	+
110	+**Approach:** A tracer bullet that runs locally. It scaffolds `roombooker` per the architecture Stack and Structural Seed, loads people from the R8 CSV, serves Pick your name with type-ahead inside the `base.html` layout, remembers the pick in the `person_id` cookie read only by `core.current_person`, and lets a person switch name from the top bar.
111	+
112	+## Boundaries & Constraints
113	+
114	+**Always:** AD-1 layering (seed CLI is the only other importer of `people.store`); AD-6 cookie `person_id` = `people.id`, 400 days, `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Lax`, unsigned, `Secure` only when `ROOMBOOKER_ENV=production`; AD-10 schema only via Alembic; AD-11 pragmas `journal_mode=WAL`, `busy_timeout=5000`, `foreign_keys=ON` on every connection; settings only from `ROOMBOOKER_DB_PATH` (default `var/roombooker.db`) and `ROOMBOOKER_ENV` (default `local`); every route works on a full page load and enhances with htmx; DESIGN.md tokens as CSS custom properties; tap targets ≥ 44px, body text 16px; stdlib logging of each seed run and each pick, naming the `person_id`.
115	+
116	+**Never:** rooms, bookings, tabs (R9: no screen exists yet), Docker/Caddy/Litestream, CI, a JSON API, a JS framework or bundler, a CSS framework, `create_all` outside tests, deleting people, editing people or offices in the app.

121	+|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
122	+| First load | CSV `email,name,office,office_manager`; empty DB | Offices created by name; people inserted active; `office_manager` true for `true/yes/1` (any case), false for `false/no/0`/blank | No error |
123	+| Reload | CSV drops person A, changes B's name, re-adds inactive C | A `active=false` with the same id; B updated in place (same id); C active again; offices never deleted | No error |
124	+| Bad CSV | Missing column, duplicate email, unknown `office_manager` value, empty name or email | Nothing written | Non-zero exit, message names the row and problem |
125	+| Search | `q="ann"` | Active people whose name contains it, case-insensitive, sorted by name, max 20, each with home office | Empty `q` shows "Start typing your name."; no match shows "No one called “{q}”." |

127	+| Guarded page | No cookie, junk cookie, unknown or inactive id | 303 to `/pick-name?next=<requested path+query>`; htmx request gets `HX-Redirect` instead | Bad cookie is cleared |

166	+## Implementation Notes
167	+
168	+- GET routes (`/`, `/pick-name`) also answer `HEAD`, so the Verification `curl -sI` gets the 303 rather than FastAPI's default 405.
169	+- `/pick-name` is one URL for both the full page and the htmx fragment (fragment when `HX-Request: true`, `Vary: HX-Request`), so it works on a full page load.
170	+- A refused pick (inactive, unknown or junk id) redirects to `/pick-name?next=...&gone=1`, which shows "That name is no longer in the list. Pick yours again." in the `aria-live` region; the notice uses navy tint, not error red (DESIGN.md keeps red for refused bookings and failed saves).
171	+- `safe_next` also maps `next` values pointing back at `/pick-name`, containing backslashes or control characters, to `/`.
172	+- The seed also refuses an empty office and a file with no people rows (so an empty file cannot mark everyone inactive). It reports every problem in the file, one per line, as `line N: problem`. Emails are lower-cased before matching.
173	+- `migrations/env.py` does not import `people.store` (AD-1); migrations are hand-written, no autogenerate.
174	+- The e2e harness starts the server with the README commands (alembic, seed, uvicorn) run with the venv's Python on a free port; the AC4 test checks `HEAD /` gives 303 to `/pick-name?next=/` and that it serves Pick your name.

737	+"""Tables and queries for `offices` and `people`.
738	+
739	+Imported only by `people.service` and the seed CLI (AD-1). The tables are created
740	+by Alembic (AD-10); these definitions describe them for queries.
741	+"""
742	+
743	+from collections.abc import Iterable, Sequence
744	+from dataclasses import dataclass
745	+
746	+from sqlalchemy import (
747	+    Boolean,
748	+    Column,
749	+    ForeignKey,
750	+    Integer,
751	+    MetaData,
752	+    Row,
753	+    String,
754	+    Table,
755	+    func,
756	+    insert,
757	+    select,
758	+    update,
759	+)
760	+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
761	+
762	+metadata = MetaData()
763	+
764	+offices = Table(
765	+    "offices",
766	+    metadata,
767	+    Column("id", Integer, primary_key=True),
768	+    Column("name", String, nullable=False, unique=True),
769	+)
770	+
771	+people = Table(
772	+    "people",
773	+    metadata,
774	+    Column("id", Integer, primary_key=True),
775	+    Column("email", String, nullable=False, unique=True),
776	+    Column("name", String, nullable=False),
777	+    Column("home_office_id", Integer, ForeignKey("offices.id"), nullable=False),
778	+    Column("is_office_manager", Boolean, nullable=False, default=False),
779	+    Column("active", Boolean, nullable=False, default=True),
780	+)
781	+
782	+_person_columns = (
783	+    people.c.id,
784	+    people.c.email,
785	+    people.c.name,
786	+    people.c.home_office_id,
787	+    offices.c.name.label("home_office_name"),
788	+    people.c.is_office_manager,
789	+    people.c.active,
790	+)
791	+
792	+
793	+def _person_select():
794	+    return select(*_person_columns).join(offices, people.c.home_office_id == offices.c.id)
795	+
796	+
797	+def search_active(session: Session, text: str, limit: int) -> Sequence[Row]:
798	+    """Active people whose name contains `text`, ignoring case, sorted by name."""
799	+    stmt = (
800	+        _person_select()
801	+        .where(people.c.active.is_(True))
802	+        .where(func.lower(people.c.name).contains(text.lower(), autoescape=True))
803	+        .order_by(func.lower(people.c.name), people.c.id)
804	+        .limit(limit)
805	+    )
806	+    return session.execute(stmt).all()
807	+

810	+    return session.execute(_person_select().where(people.c.id == person_id)).first()

813	+# --- writes, used only by the seed CLI (AD-3, AD-9) ---------------------------
814	+
815	+
816	+@dataclass(frozen=True)
817	+class PersonRecord:
818	+    email: str
819	+    name: str
820	+    office: str
821	+    is_office_manager: bool
822	+
823	+
824	+@dataclass(frozen=True)
825	+class LoadResult:
826	+    offices_created: int
827	+    offices_total: int
828	+    added: int
829	+    updated: int
830	+    reactivated: int
831	+    deactivated_ids: tuple[int, ...]
832	+
833	+
834	+def ensure_offices(session: Session, names: Iterable[str]) -> tuple[dict[str, int], int]:
835	+    """Create any missing offices by name. Returns name -> id and how many were created."""
836	+    existing = {name: id_ for id_, name in session.execute(select(offices.c.id, offices.c.name))}
837	+    created = 0
838	+    for name in sorted(set(names) - existing.keys()):
839	+        existing[name] = session.execute(insert(offices).values(name=name)).inserted_primary_key[0]
840	+        created += 1
841	+    return existing, created
842	+
843	+
844	+def load_people(session: Session, records: Sequence[PersonRecord]) -> LoadResult:
845	+    """Upsert people keyed on email; mark anyone missing inactive. Never deletes."""
846	+    office_ids, offices_created = ensure_offices(session, (r.office for r in records))
847	+    current = {
848	+        row.email: row
849	+        for row in session.execute(select(people.c.id, people.c.email, people.c.active))
850	+    }
851	+    added = updated = reactivated = 0
852	+    for record in records:
853	+        values = {
854	+            "name": record.name,
855	+            "home_office_id": office_ids[record.office],
856	+            "is_office_manager": record.is_office_manager,
857	+            "active": True,
858	+        }
859	+        row = current.get(record.email)
860	+        if row is None:
861	+            session.execute(insert(people).values(email=record.email, **values))
862	+            added += 1
863	+        else:
864	+            session.execute(update(people).where(people.c.id == row.id).values(**values))
865	+            updated += 1
866	+            if not row.active:
867	+                reactivated += 1
868	+
869	+    seen = {r.email for r in records}
870	+    deactivated = tuple(
871	+        sorted(row.id for email, row in current.items() if row.active and email not in seen)
872	+    )
873	+    if deactivated:
874	+        session.execute(update(people).where(people.c.id.in_(deactivated)).values(active=False))
875	+
876	+    return LoadResult(
877	+        offices_created=offices_created,
878	+        offices_total=len(office_ids),
879	+        added=added,
880	+        updated=updated,
881	+        reactivated=reactivated,
882	+        deactivated_ids=deactivated,
883	+    )

966	+"""Load or reload offices and people from a CSV (R8, AD-9).
967	+
968	+    python -m roombooker.seed <file.csv>
969	+
970	+Columns: email, name, office, office_manager. People are matched on email; anyone
971	+missing from the file is marked inactive and keeps their id. Offices are created by
972	+name and never deleted. The whole file loads in one transaction, or nothing does.
973	+"""
974	+
975	+import argparse
976	+import csv
977	+import logging
978	+import sys
979	+from collections.abc import Sequence
980	+from pathlib import Path
981	+
982	+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
983	+
984	+from roombooker.core.db import get_engine
985	+from roombooker.people import store
986	+
987	+log = logging.getLogger("roombooker.seed")
988	+
989	+COLUMNS = ("email", "name", "office", "office_manager")
990	+TRUE_VALUES = {"true", "yes", "1"}
991	+FALSE_VALUES = {"false", "no", "0", ""}
992	+
993	+
994	+class SeedError(Exception):
995	+    """The file cannot be loaded. Each problem names its line."""
996	+
997	+    def __init__(self, problems: list[str]):
998	+        super().__init__("\n".join(problems))
999	+        self.problems = problems
1000	+
1001	+
1002	+def parse(path: Path) -> list[store.PersonRecord]:
1003	+    """Read and validate the whole file. Raises SeedError listing every problem."""
1004	+    try:
1005	+        handle = path.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig")
1006	+    except OSError as exc:
1007	+        raise SeedError([f"{path}: cannot open ({exc.strerror})"]) from exc
1008	+
1009	+    with handle:
1010	+        reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
1011	+        header = [(name or "").strip().lower() for name in reader.fieldnames or []]
1012	+        missing = [c for c in COLUMNS if c not in header]
1013	+        if missing:
1014	+            names = ", ".join(missing)
1015	+            raise SeedError([f"line 1: missing column{'s' if len(missing) > 1 else ''} {names}"])
1016	+        reader.fieldnames = header
1017	+
1018	+        problems: list[str] = []
1019	+        records: list[store.PersonRecord] = []
1020	+        first_line_for_email: dict[str, int] = {}
1021	+        for row in reader:
1022	+            line = reader.line_num
1023	+            email = (row.get("email") or "").strip().lower()
1024	+            name = (row.get("name") or "").strip()
1025	+            office = (row.get("office") or "").strip()
1026	+            flag = (row.get("office_manager") or "").strip().lower()
1027	+
1028	+            row_problems = []
1029	+            if not email:
1030	+                row_problems.append("empty email")
1031	+            if not name:
1032	+                row_problems.append("empty name")
1033	+            if not office:
1034	+                row_problems.append("empty office")
1035	+            if flag not in TRUE_VALUES | FALSE_VALUES:
1036	+                row_problems.append(
1037	+                    f"unknown office_manager value {row.get('office_manager', '').strip()!r} "
1038	+                    "(use true/yes/1, false/no/0 or leave blank)"
1039	+                )
1040	+            if email and email in first_line_for_email:
1041	+                row_problems.append(
1042	+                    f"duplicate email {email} (first on line {first_line_for_email[email]})"
1043	+                )
1044	+            elif email:
1045	+                first_line_for_email[email] = line
1046	+
1047	+            if row_problems:
1048	+                problems.extend(f"line {line}: {p}" for p in row_problems)
1049	+            else:
1050	+                records.append(store.PersonRecord(email, name, office, flag in TRUE_VALUES))
1051	+
1052	+    if problems:
1053	+        raise SeedError(problems)
1054	+    if not records:
1055	+        raise SeedError([f"{path}: no people in the file; refusing to mark everyone inactive"])
1056	+    return records
1057	+
1058	+
1059	+def load(path: Path) -> store.LoadResult:
1060	+    """Validate `path`, then load it in one transaction."""
1061	+    records = parse(path)
1062	+    with Session(get_engine()) as session, session.begin():
1063	+        return store.load_people(session, records)
1064	+
1065	+
1066	+def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
1067	+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m roombooker.seed", description=__doc__.split("\n")[0])
1068	+    parser.add_argument("csv_file", type=Path, help="CSV with columns " + ", ".join(COLUMNS))
1069	+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
1070	+
1071	+    try:
1072	+        result = load(args.csv_file)
1073	+    except SeedError as exc:
1074	+        log.error("seed: %s not loaded, nothing written", args.csv_file)
1075	+        for problem in exc.problems:
1076	+            print(f"error: {problem}", file=sys.stderr)
1077	+        return 1
1078	+
1079	+    log.info(
1080	+        "seed: loaded %s: %d offices (%d new), people %d added, %d updated (%d reactivated), "
1081	+        "%d marked inactive",
1082	+        args.csv_file,
1083	+        result.offices_total,
1084	+        result.offices_created,
1085	+        result.added,
1086	+        result.updated,
1087	+        result.reactivated,
1088	+        len(result.deactivated_ids),
1089	+    )
1090	+    for person_id in result.deactivated_ids:
1091	+        log.info("seed: marked inactive person_id=%d", person_id)
1092	+    return 0
1093	+
1094	+
1095	+if __name__ == "__main__":
1096	+    logging.basicConfig(
1097	+        level=logging.INFO, format="%(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s", stream=sys.stdout
1098	+    )
1099	+    sys.exit(main())

 # room-booker
+
+Company Room Booking: internal room booking for the London, Manchester and Leeds offices.
+One FastAPI app, one SQLite file, server-rendered pages with htmx.
+
+## First local run
+
+You need [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/). It installs Python 3.14 for you if it is missing.
+
+Run these from the repository root, in order:
+
+```sh
+uv sync                                                  # install Python 3.14 and dependencies
+uv run alembic upgrade head                              # create the database in var/roombooker.db
+uv run python -m roombooker.seed seeds/build-people.csv  # load the made-up offices and people
+uv run uvicorn roombooker.app:app                        # serve the app
+```
+
+Open <http://127.0.0.1:8000/>. You land on Pick your name; type part of a name and pick it.
+Your name then shows in the top bar; tap it to switch to someone else.
+
+## Loading people
+
+The same command loads the build seed and HR's list:
+
+```sh
+uv run python -m roombooker.seed path/to/people.csv
+```
+
+The CSV has the columns `email,name,office,office_manager`. Offices are created by name.
+`office_manager` is `true`, `yes` or `1` for an office manager, and `false`, `no`, `0` or blank otherwise.
+People are matched on email: a reload updates them in place, and anyone missing from the file is
+marked inactive (never deleted), so everyone keeps their id. If any row is wrong, nothing is loaded
+and the command exits non-zero, naming the line and the problem.
+
+## Settings
+
+| Variable | Default | Meaning |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `ROOMBOOKER_DB_PATH` | `var/roombooker.db` | SQLite file; its folder is created if missing |
+| `ROOMBOOKER_ENV` | `local` | `production` marks the name cookie `Secure` (HTTPS only) |
+
+## Tests
+
+```sh
+uv run playwright install chromium   # once, for the browser tests
+uv run pytest                        # all tests, including browser tests at laptop and phone widths
+uv run pytest --ignore=tests/e2e     # without the browser tests
+```
+
+## Schema changes
+
+Every table change is an Alembic migration in `migrations/versions/`; run `uv run alembic upgrade head`
+before starting the app.

+## Implementation Notes
+
+- GET routes (`/`, `/pick-name`) also answer `HEAD`, so the Verification `curl -sI` gets the 303 rather than FastAPI's default 405.
+- `/pick-name` is one URL for both the full page and the htmx fragment (fragment when `HX-Request: true`, `Vary: HX-Request`), so it works on a full page load.

+"""Alembic environment. The URL comes from roombooker.core.settings (AD-10, AD-11)."""
+
+from logging.config import fileConfig
+
+from alembic import context
+
+from roombooker.core.db import make_engine
+from roombooker.core.settings import get_settings
+
+config = context.config
+
+if config.config_file_name is not None and config.attributes.get("configure_logger", True):
+    fileConfig(config.config_file_name, disable_existing_loggers=False)
+
+# Migrations are written by hand; no autogenerate, so no app metadata is imported here.
+target_metadata = None
+
+
+def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
+    context.configure(
+        url=get_settings().database_url,
+        target_metadata=target_metadata,
+        literal_binds=True,
+        render_as_batch=True,
+    )
+    with context.begin_transaction():
+        context.run_migrations()
+
+
+def run_migrations_online() -> None:
+    engine = make_engine(get_settings().db_path)
+    try:
+        with engine.connect() as connection:
+            context.configure(
+                connection=connection,
+                target_metadata=target_metadata,
+                render_as_batch=True,
+            )
+            with context.begin_transaction():
+                context.run_migrations()
+    finally:
+        engine.dispose()
+
+
+if context.is_offline_mode():
+    run_migrations_offline()
+else:
+    run_migrations_online()

+"""SQLite engine and session (AD-11 pragmas on every connection)."""
+
+from collections.abc import Iterator
+from functools import lru_cache
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from sqlalchemy import Engine, create_engine, event
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from roombooker.core.settings import get_settings
+
+PRAGMAS = (
+    "PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL",
+    "PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000",
+    "PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON",
+)
+
+
+def _apply_pragmas(dbapi_connection, _connection_record) -> None:
+    cursor = dbapi_connection.cursor()
+    try:
+        for pragma in PRAGMAS:
+            cursor.execute(pragma)
+    finally:
+        cursor.close()
+
+
+def make_engine(db_path: Path) -> Engine:
+    """Create an engine for `db_path`, creating its parent folder if needed."""
+    db_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{db_path}")
+    event.listen(engine, "connect", _apply_pragmas)
+    return engine
+
+
+@lru_cache
+def _engine_for(db_path: Path) -> Engine:
+    return make_engine(db_path)
+
+
+def get_engine() -> Engine:
+    """The shared engine for the configured database path."""
+    return _engine_for(get_settings().db_path)
+
+
+def get_session() -> Iterator[Session]:
+    """FastAPI dependency: one session per request."""
+    with Session(get_engine(), expire_on_commit=False) as session:
+        yield session

+"""The one way to know who is using the app (AD-6).
+
+`current_person` is the only reader of the `person_id` cookie. When the cookie is
+missing or names an unknown or inactive person it raises `NeedsPerson`, which the
+handler registered in `app.py` turns into a trip to Pick your name and back.
+"""
+
+from typing import Annotated
+from urllib.parse import quote, urlsplit
+
+from fastapi import Depends, Request, Response
+from fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from roombooker.core.db import get_session
+from roombooker.core.settings import get_settings
+from roombooker.people import service as people_service
+from roombooker.people.service import Person
+
+COOKIE_NAME = "person_id"
+COOKIE_MAX_AGE = 400 * 24 * 60 * 60  # 400 days
+PICK_PATH = "/pick-name"
+
+
+class NeedsPerson(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, next_url: str, clear_cookie: bool = False):
+        super().__init__(next_url)
+        self.next_url = next_url
+        self.clear_cookie = clear_cookie
+
+
+def path_with_query(request: Request) -> str:
+    query = request.url.query
+    return request.url.path + (f"?{query}" if query else "")
+
+
+def pick_url(next_url: str) -> str:
+    """URL of Pick your name that returns to `next_url` afterwards."""
+    return f"{PICK_PATH}?next={quote(safe_next(next_url), safe='/')}"
+
+
+def safe_next(next_url: str | None) -> str:
+    """`next_url` when it is a local path, otherwise `/`."""
+    if not next_url or not next_url.startswith("/") or next_url.startswith("//"):
+        return "/"
+    if "\\" in next_url or any(ord(ch) < 0x20 or ord(ch) == 0x7F for ch in next_url):
+        return "/"
+    parts = urlsplit(next_url)
+    if parts.scheme or parts.netloc or parts.path.startswith(PICK_PATH):
+        return "/"
+    return next_url
+
+
+def current_person(
+    request: Request, session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]
+) -> Person:
+    """FastAPI dependency: the person using the app, or a redirect to Pick your name."""
+    raw = request.cookies.get(COOKIE_NAME)
+    person = None
+    if raw is not None and raw.isascii() and raw.isdigit():
+        person = people_service.get_active_person(session, int(raw))
+    if person is None:
+        raise NeedsPerson(path_with_query(request), clear_cookie=raw is not None)
+    return person
+
+
+CurrentPerson = Annotated[Person, Depends(current_person)]
+
+
+def remember_person(response: Response, person_id: int) -> None:
+    """Set the `person_id` cookie (AD-6)."""
+    response.set_cookie(
+        COOKIE_NAME,
+        str(person_id),
+        max_age=COOKIE_MAX_AGE,
+        path="/",
+        httponly=True,
+        samesite="lax",
+        secure=get_settings().is_production,
+    )
+
+
+def _forget_person(response: Response) -> None:
+    response.delete_cookie(
+        COOKIE_NAME,
+        path="/",
+        httponly=True,
+        samesite="lax",
+        secure=get_settings().is_production,
+    )
+
+
+async def needs_person_handler(request: Request, exc: NeedsPerson) -> Response:
+    """htmx requests get `HX-Redirect`; full page loads get a 303."""
+    target = pick_url(exc.next_url)
+    if request.headers.get("HX-Request") == "true":
+        response: Response = Response(status_code=200, headers={"HX-Redirect": target})
+    else:
+        response = RedirectResponse(target, status_code=303)
+    if exc.clear_cookie:
+        _forget_person(response)
+    return response

+"""People rules: who is active, and finding people by name.
+
+Must never import `core.identity` (it imports this module).
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+from sqlalchemy import Row
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from roombooker.people import store
+
+SEARCH_LIMIT = 20
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Person:
+    id: int
+    email: str
+    name: str
+    home_office_id: int
+    home_office_name: str
+    is_office_manager: bool
+
+
+def _to_person(row: Row) -> Person:
+    return Person(
+        id=row.id,
+        email=row.email,
+        name=row.name,
+        home_office_id=row.home_office_id,
+        home_office_name=row.home_office_name,
+        is_office_manager=row.is_office_manager,
+    )
+
+
+def search_active_people(session: Session, text: str) -> list[Person]:
+    """Active people whose name contains `text` (case-insensitive), sorted by name, at most 20.
+
+    Blank text matches no one.
+    """
+    text = text.strip()
+    if not text:
+        return []
+    return [_to_person(row) for row in store.search_active(session, text, SEARCH_LIMIT)]
+
+
+def get_active_person(session: Session, person_id: int) -> Person | None:
+    """The person with this id, or None when unknown or inactive."""
+    row = store.get_person(session, person_id)
+    if row is None or not row.active:
+        return None
+    return _to_person(row)

+"""Tables and queries for `offices` and `people`.
+
+Imported only by `people.service` and the seed CLI (AD-1). The tables are created
+by Alembic (AD-10); these definitions describe them for queries.
+"""
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable, Sequence
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+from sqlalchemy import (
+    Boolean,
+    Column,
+    ForeignKey,
+    Integer,
+    MetaData,
+    Row,
+    String,
+    Table,
+    func,
+    insert,
+    select,
+    update,
+)
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+metadata = MetaData()
+
+offices = Table(
+    "offices",
+    metadata,
+    Column("id", Integer, primary_key=True),
+    Column("name", String, nullable=False, unique=True),
+)
+
+people = Table(
+    "people",
+    metadata,
+    Column("id", Integer, primary_key=True),
+    Column("email", String, nullable=False, unique=True),
+    Column("name", String, nullable=False),
+    Column("home_office_id", Integer, ForeignKey("offices.id"), nullable=False),
+    Column("is_office_manager", Boolean, nullable=False, default=False),
+    Column("active", Boolean, nullable=False, default=True),
+)
+
+_person_columns = (
+    people.c.id,
+    people.c.email,
+    people.c.name,
+    people.c.home_office_id,
+    offices.c.name.label("home_office_name"),
+    people.c.is_office_manager,
+    people.c.active,
+)
+
+
+def _person_select():
+    return select(*_person_columns).join(offices, people.c.home_office_id == offices.c.id)
+
+
+def search_active(session: Session, text: str, limit: int) -> Sequence[Row]:
+    """Active people whose name contains `text`, ignoring case, sorted by name."""
+    stmt = (
+        _person_select()
+        .where(people.c.active.is_(True))
+        .where(func.lower(people.c.name).contains(text.lower(), autoescape=True))
+        .order_by(func.lower(people.c.name), people.c.id)
+        .limit(limit)
+    )
+    return session.execute(stmt).all()
+
+
+def get_person(session: Session, person_id: int) -> Row | None:
+    return session.execute(_person_select().where(people.c.id == person_id)).first()
+
+
+# --- writes, used only by the seed CLI (AD-3, AD-9) ---------------------------
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class PersonRecord:
+    email: str
+    name: str
+    office: str
+    is_office_manager: bool
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class LoadResult:
+    offices_created: int
+    offices_total: int
+    added: int
+    updated: int
+    reactivated: int
+    deactivated_ids: tuple[int, ...]
+
+
+def ensure_offices(session: Session, names: Iterable[str]) -> tuple[dict[str, int], int]:
+    """Create any missing offices by name. Returns name -> id and how many were created."""
+    existing = {name: id_ for id_, name in session.execute(select(offices.c.id, offices.c.name))}
+    created = 0
+    for name in sorted(set(names) - existing.keys()):
+        existing[name] = session.execute(insert(offices).values(name=name)).inserted_primary_key[0]
+        created += 1
+    return existing, created
+
+
+def load_people(session: Session, records: Sequence[PersonRecord]) -> LoadResult:
+    """Upsert people keyed on email; mark anyone missing inactive. Never deletes."""
+    office_ids, offices_created = ensure_offices(session, (r.office for r in records))
+    current = {
+        row.email: row
+        for row in session.execute(select(people.c.id, people.c.email, people.c.active))
+    }
+    added = updated = reactivated = 0
+    for record in records:
+        values = {
+            "name": record.name,
+            "home_office_id": office_ids[record.office],
+            "is_office_manager": record.is_office_manager,
+            "active": True,
+        }
+        row = current.get(record.email)
+        if row is None:
+            session.execute(insert(people).values(email=record.email, **values))
+            added += 1
+        else:
+            session.execute(update(people).where(people.c.id == row.id).values(**values))
+            updated += 1
+            if not row.active:
+                reactivated += 1
+
+    seen = {r.email for r in records}
+    deactivated = tuple(
+        sorted(row.id for email, row in current.items() if row.active and email not in seen)
+    )
+    if deactivated:
+        session.execute(update(people).where(people.c.id.in_(deactivated)).values(active=False))
+
+    return LoadResult(
+        offices_created=offices_created,
+        offices_total=len(office_ids),
+        added=added,
+        updated=updated,
+        reactivated=reactivated,
+        deactivated_ids=deactivated,
+    )

+"""Pick your name, and the landing page until Rooms exists (R1, R2, R9)."""
+
+import logging
+from typing import Annotated
+
+from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Query, Request
+from fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse, Response
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from roombooker.core.db import get_session
+from roombooker.core.identity import CurrentPerson, pick_url, remember_person, safe_next
+from roombooker.people import service
+
+log = logging.getLogger("roombooker.people")
+
+router = APIRouter()
+
+DbSession = Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]
+
+
+def _render(request: Request, template: str, **context) -> Response:
+    return request.app.state.templates.TemplateResponse(request, template, context)
+
+
+@router.api_route("/", methods=["GET", "HEAD"])
+def landing(request: Request, person: CurrentPerson) -> Response:
+    return _render(request, "people/landing.html", person=person)
+
+
+@router.api_route("/pick-name", methods=["GET", "HEAD"])
+def pick_name(
+    request: Request,
+    session: DbSession,
+    q: str = "",
+    next_url: Annotated[str, Query(alias="next")] = "/",
+    gone: bool = False,
+) -> Response:
+    q = q.strip()
+    context = {
+        "q": q,
+        "next": safe_next(next_url),
+        "people": service.search_active_people(session, q),
+        "gone": gone,
+    }
+    is_htmx = request.headers.get("HX-Request") == "true"
+    template = "people/_results.html" if is_htmx else "people/pick_name.html"
+    response = _render(request, template, **context)
+    response.headers["Vary"] = "HX-Request"
+    return response
+
+
+@router.post("/pick-name")
+def pick(
+    session: DbSession,
+    person_id: Annotated[str, Form()] = "",
+    next_url: Annotated[str, Form(alias="next")] = "/",
+) -> Response:
+    target = safe_next(next_url)
+    person_id = person_id.strip()
+    person = None
+    if person_id.isascii() and person_id.isdigit():
+        person = service.get_active_person(session, int(person_id))
+    if person is None:
+        log.info("pick refused: person_id=%r is unknown or inactive", person_id)
+        return RedirectResponse(f"{pick_url(target)}&gone=1", status_code=303)
+
+    response = RedirectResponse(target, status_code=303)
+    remember_person(response, person.id)
+    log.info("pick: person_id=%d picked their name, next=%s", person.id, target)
+    return response

+"""Load or reload offices and people from a CSV (R8, AD-9).
+
+    python -m roombooker.seed <file.csv>
+
+Columns: email, name, office, office_manager. People are matched on email; anyone
+missing from the file is marked inactive and keeps their id. Offices are created by
+name and never deleted. The whole file loads in one transaction, or nothing does.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import csv
+import logging
+import sys
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
+
+from roombooker.core.db import get_engine
+from roombooker.people import store
+
+log = logging.getLogger("roombooker.seed")
+
+COLUMNS = ("email", "name", "office", "office_manager")
+TRUE_VALUES = {"true", "yes", "1"}
+FALSE_VALUES = {"false", "no", "0", ""}
+
+
+class SeedError(Exception):
+    """The file cannot be loaded. Each problem names its line."""
+
+    def __init__(self, problems: list[str]):
+        super().__init__("\n".join(problems))
+        self.problems = problems
+
+
+def parse(path: Path) -> list[store.PersonRecord]:
+    """Read and validate the whole file. Raises SeedError listing every problem."""
+    try:
+        handle = path.open(newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig")
+    except OSError as exc:
+        raise SeedError([f"{path}: cannot open ({exc.strerror})"]) from exc
+
+    with handle:
+        reader = csv.DictReader(handle)
+        header = [(name or "").strip().lower() for name in reader.fieldnames or []]
+        missing = [c for c in COLUMNS if c not in header]
+        if missing:
+            names = ", ".join(missing)
+            raise SeedError([f"line 1: missing column{'s' if len(missing) > 1 else ''} {names}"])
+        reader.fieldnames = header
+
+        problems: list[str] = []
+        records: list[store.PersonRecord] = []
+        first_line_for_email: dict[str, int] = {}
+        for row in reader:
+            line = reader.line_num
+            email = (row.get("email") or "").strip().lower()
+            name = (row.get("name") or "").strip()
+            office = (row.get("office") or "").strip()
+            flag = (row.get("office_manager") or "").strip().lower()
+
+            row_problems = []
+            if not email:
+                row_problems.append("empty email")
+            if not name:
+                row_problems.append("empty name")
+            if not office:
+                row_problems.append("empty office")
+            if flag not in TRUE_VALUES | FALSE_VALUES:
+                row_problems.append(
+                    f"unknown office_manager value {row.get('office_manager', '').strip()!r} "
+                    "(use true/yes/1, false/no/0 or leave blank)"
+                )
+            if email and email in first_line_for_email:
+                row_problems.append(
+                    f"duplicate email {email} (first on line {first_line_for_email[email]})"
+                )
+            elif email:
+                first_line_for_email[email] = line
+
+            if row_problems:
+                problems.extend(f"line {line}: {p}" for p in row_problems)
+            else:
+                records.append(store.PersonRecord(email, name, office, flag in TRUE_VALUES))
+
+    if problems:
+        raise SeedError(problems)
+    if not records:
+        raise SeedError([f"{path}: no people in the file; refusing to mark everyone inactive"])
+    return records
+
+
+def load(path: Path) -> store.LoadResult:
+    """Validate `path`, then load it in one transaction."""
+    records = parse(path)
+    with Session(get_engine()) as session, session.begin():
+        return store.load_people(session, records)
+
+
+def main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m roombooker.seed", description=__doc__.split("\n")[0])
+    parser.add_argument("csv_file", type=Path, help="CSV with columns " + ", ".join(COLUMNS))
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+    try:
+        result = load(args.csv_file)
+    except SeedError as exc:
+        log.error("seed: %s not loaded, nothing written", args.csv_file)
+        for problem in exc.problems:
+            print(f"error: {problem}", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+
+    log.info(
+        "seed: loaded %s: %d offices (%d new), people %d added, %d updated (%d reactivated), "
+        "%d marked inactive",
+        args.csv_file,
+        result.offices_total,
+        result.offices_created,
+        result.added,
+        result.updated,
+        result.reactivated,
+        len(result.deactivated_ids),
+    )
+    for person_id in result.deactivated_ids:
+        log.info("seed: marked inactive person_id=%d", person_id)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    logging.basicConfig(
+        level=logging.INFO, format="%(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s", stream=sys.stdout
+    )
+    sys.exit(main())

+"""Shared fixtures: a temporary SQLite file migrated to head through Alembic."""
+
+import sqlite3
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+from alembic import command
+from alembic.config import Config
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+from roombooker import seed
+from roombooker.app import create_app
+from roombooker.core import db
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+CSV_HEADER = "email,name,office,office_manager"
+
+
+def migrate_to_head() -> None:
+    config = Config(str(ROOT / "alembic.ini"))
+    config.attributes["configure_logger"] = False  # keep pytest's log capture intact
+    command.upgrade(config, "head")
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def db_path(tmp_path, monkeypatch) -> Path:
+    path = tmp_path / "var" / "roombooker.db"
+    monkeypatch.setenv("ROOMBOOKER_DB_PATH", str(path))
+    monkeypatch.delenv("ROOMBOOKER_ENV", raising=False)
+    migrate_to_head()
+    yield path
+    db.get_engine().dispose()
+    db._engine_for.cache_clear()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def load_csv(db_path, tmp_path):
+    """Write CSV lines (after the header) to a file and run the seed CLI on it."""
+    counter = iter(range(1, 1_000))
+
+    def _load(*lines: str, header: str = CSV_HEADER) -> int:
+        path = tmp_path / f"people-{next(counter)}.csv"
+        path.write_text("\n".join([header, *lines]) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+        return seed.main([str(path)])
+
+    return _load
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def people(db_path):
+    """Read the people table as {email: row dict}, straight from the file."""
+
+    def _people() -> dict[str, dict]:
+        with sqlite3.connect(db_path) as conn:
+            conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
+            rows = conn.execute(
+                "SELECT p.id, p.email, p.name, o.name AS office, p.is_office_manager, p.active "
+                "FROM people p JOIN offices o ON o.id = p.home_office_id"
+            ).fetchall()
+        return {row["email"]: dict(row) for row in rows}
+
+    return _people
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def client(db_path) -> TestClient:
+    with TestClient(create_app(), follow_redirects=False) as test_client:
+        yield test_client

@@ -0,0 +1,104 @@
+"""Browser end-to-end harness: Uvicorn on a temporary database, Playwright at two widths.
+
+The server is started with the README commands (migrate, seed, run), run with this
+virtualenv's Python instead of `uv run`, on a free port.
+Needs a browser: `uv run playwright install chromium`.
+"""
+
+import os
+import socket
+import sqlite3
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import httpx
+import pytest
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+BUILD_SEED = ROOT / "seeds" / "build-people.csv"
+
+VIEWPORTS = {
+    "laptop": {"width": 1280, "height": 800},
+    "phone": {"width": 390, "height": 844},
+}
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class LiveServer:
+    url: str
+    db_path: Path
+    env: dict[str, str]
+
+    def seed(self, csv_path: Path) -> None:
+        """Run the seed CLI against the server's database, as a person would."""
+        subprocess.run(
+            [sys.executable, "-m", "roombooker.seed", str(csv_path)],
+            cwd=ROOT,
+            env=self.env,
+            check=True,
+            capture_output=True,
+        )
+
+    def person_ids(self) -> dict[str, tuple[int, int]]:
+        """{email: (id, active)} read straight from the database file."""
+        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
+            return {e: (i, a) for i, e, a in conn.execute("SELECT id, email, active FROM people")}
+
+
+def _free_port() -> int:
+    with socket.socket() as sock:
+        sock.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
+        return sock.getsockname()[1]
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="session")
+def live_server(tmp_path_factory):
+    db_path = tmp_path_factory.mktemp("e2e") / "var" / "roombooker.db"
+    env = {**os.environ, "ROOMBOOKER_DB_PATH": str(db_path)}
+    env.pop("ROOMBOOKER_ENV", None)
+    port = _free_port()
+
+    subprocess.run(
+        [sys.executable, "-m", "alembic", "upgrade", "head"],
+        cwd=ROOT, env=env, check=True, capture_output=True,
+    )
+    server = LiveServer(url=f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}", db_path=db_path, env=env)
+    server.seed(BUILD_SEED)
+
+    process = subprocess.Popen(
+        [sys.executable, "-m", "uvicorn", "roombooker.app:app", "--port", str(port)],
+        cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+    )
+    try:
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + 20
+        while True:
+            try:
+                httpx.get(f"{server.url}/pick-name", timeout=1)
+                break
+            except httpx.TransportError:
+                if process.poll() is not None or time.monotonic() > deadline:
+                    raise RuntimeError("Uvicorn did not start") from None
+                time.sleep(0.1)
+        yield server
+    finally:
+        process.terminate()
+        process.wait(timeout=10)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def build_seed_loaded(live_server):
+    """Each test starts with everyone in the build seed active (a reload reactivates)."""
+    live_server.seed(BUILD_SEED)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(params=list(VIEWPORTS), ids=list(VIEWPORTS))
+def viewport(request) -> dict[str, int]:
+    return VIEWPORTS[request.param]
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def context(new_context, live_server, viewport):
+    return new_context(base_url=live_server.url, viewport=viewport)

+"""The story's verify, in a real browser at laptop (1280x800) and phone (390x844) widths."""
+
+import re
+
+import httpx
+from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect
+
+from tests.e2e.conftest import BUILD_SEED
+
+
+def pick(page: Page, typed: str, name: str) -> None:
+    """On Pick your name: type part of a name, wait for the type-ahead, pick `name`."""
+    url_before = page.url
+    page.get_by_label("Your name").fill(typed)
+    button = page.get_by_role("button", name=re.compile(rf"^{re.escape(name)}\b"))
+    expect(button).to_be_visible()
+    assert page.url == url_before  # results came by htmx, not a page load
+    button.click()
+
+
+def top_bar_name(page: Page):
+    return page.locator(".top-bar .current-person-name")
+
+
+def test_readme_commands_serve_pick_your_name(live_server):
+    head = httpx.head(f"{live_server.url}/")  # what `curl -sI` sends
+    assert head.status_code == 303
+    assert head.headers["location"] == "/pick-name?next=/"
+
+    response = httpx.get(f"{live_server.url}/", follow_redirects=True)
+    assert response.url.raw_path == b"/pick-name?next=/"
+    assert '<h1 class="title">Pick your name</h1>' in response.text
+
+
+def test_pick_name_shows_in_top_bar_after_reload(page: Page):
+    page.goto("/")
+    expect(page).to_have_url(re.compile(r"/pick-name\?next=/$"))
+
+    pick(page, "okaf", "Hannah Okafor")
+
+    expect(page).to_have_url(re.compile(r"/$"))
+    expect(top_bar_name(page)).to_have_text("Hannah Okafor")
+    expect(page.get_by_text("Booking opens soon.")).to_be_visible()
+    page.reload()
+    expect(top_bar_name(page)).to_have_text("Hannah Okafor")
+
+
+def test_switch_name_returns_to_same_page(page: Page):
+    page.goto("/?from=switch")
+    pick(page, "kowal", "Anna Kowalski")
+    expect(page).to_have_url(re.compile(r"/\?from=switch$"))
+
+    page.locator(".top-bar .current-person").click()
+    expect(page.get_by_role("heading", name="Pick your name")).to_be_visible()
+    pick(page, "tariq", "Tariq Mahmood")
+
+    expect(page).to_have_url(re.compile(r"/\?from=switch$"))
+    expect(top_bar_name(page)).to_have_text("Tariq Mahmood")
+
+
+def test_reload_without_person_sends_them_to_pick_your_name(page: Page, live_server, tmp_path):
+    page.goto("/")
+    pick(page, "adeyemi", "Ben Adeyemi")
+    expect(top_bar_name(page)).to_have_text("Ben Adeyemi")
+    before = live_server.person_ids()
+
+    lines = BUILD_SEED.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
+    without_ben = tmp_path / "without-ben.csv"
+    without_ben.write_text(
+        "\n".join(line for line in lines if not line.startswith("ben.adeyemi@")) + "\n",
+        encoding="utf-8",
+    )
+    live_server.seed(without_ben)
+
+    page.reload()
+    expect(page).to_have_url(re.compile(r"/pick-name\?next=/$"))
+    page.get_by_label("Your name").fill("adeyemi")
+    expect(page.get_by_text("No one called “adeyemi”.")).to_be_visible()
+
+    after = live_server.person_ids()
+    assert {e: i for e, (i, _) in after.items()} == {e: i for e, (i, _) in before.items()}
+    assert after["ben.adeyemi@example.com"][1] == 0
+    assert all(active for e, (_, active) in after.items() if e != "ben.adeyemi@example.com")
